items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: A cargo ship accident in January 1992 released a multitude of plastic toys into the ocean's depths. Despite the degradation of most toys over time, their remarkable journey still aids scientists in examining marine debris.

items.title: Reliance surges 11.6% as strong Q2 earnings add Rs 1.83 lakh crore in market value
items.description: Reliance Industries has seen an impressive 11.6% surge in stock price, following quarterly earnings that exceeded expectations. This remarkable rise represents the company's most significant increase in over six years. Analysts are optimistic about future growth, crediting this success to strong performance in the O2C sector and increased institutional buying. Brokerage firms predict potential earnings upgrades will further boost stock valuation.

items.title: FPI holding hits multi-year lows in 70% of top 100 Indian companies
items.description: Foreign investors have significantly reduced their holdings in nearly 70% of India's leading companies in recent years. Major firms, including banks and IT sectors, are seeing foreign ownership decline to multi-decade lows. This decrease in foreign investments mirrors diminished expectations for growth in India relative to other global markets. Although some companies experience slight increases in foreign ownership, they still remain at historical lows.

items.title: Small & midcap funds remain top bets for investors in first half of FY27
items.description: During the first half of FY27, mid-cap funds received ₹38,043 crore and small-cap funds attracted ₹42,212 crore. This increased their share in total equity inflows to 20% and 22.6%, respectively. In contrast, large-cap funds saw a decline with inflows of just ₹4,575 crore. The combined net Assets Under Management (AUM) of small and mid-cap funds rose 24% year-on-year. Overall, total equity AUM grew by nearly 12% to reach ₹33.

items.title: Texas opens 3,000-acre state park along Colorado River with $1bn fund
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Post Oak Ridge has officially opened, marking Texas' latest state park. Spanning over 3,000 acres, it features two hiking trails along four miles of scenic routes. Plans for future camping facilities and river access are on track for completion by 2029. Input from the community has been vital in guiding the park's development, as part of a larger effort to expand public outdoor spaces across Texas.

items.title: Howards Sterns honor late dog Bianca with cat adoption center, 2,000 rescues
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: After the heartbreaking passing of their bulldog, Howard and Beth Stern channeled their sorrow into meaningful change by founding Bianca's Furry Friends Feline Adoption Center, part of North Shore Animal League America. This center improves the conditions for cats waiting for adoption and boosts rescue capabilities. With over 2,000 cats fostered since 2013, Beth's dedicated efforts have played a crucial role in spotlighting the importance of adopting shelter animals nationwide.

items.title: Olivia Newton-John bought farm for $622,000, later sold it for $4.6m
items.author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
items.description: Olivia Newton-John owned a country estate in Australia that she transformed over nearly four decades. This property included natural features and a significant amount of wildlife habitat that she developed. After battling cancer, the estate was sold in 2019 for $4.6 million, reflecting changes in her priorities. Newton-John's connection to the area continued through her involvement with a wellness retreat she co-founded.

items.title: India moves to resolve Scotch tariff dispute, assures 75% duty on bulk imports
items.author: ARYAN SINGH
items.description: The government is addressing a dispute regarding reduced import duties on bulk Scotch whisky imports. Liquor industry executives were assured that these imports qualify for the 75 percent duty reduction. The disagreement arose after tax officials questioned the eligibility of bulk shipments under the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement. Major liquor companies, including Diageo and Pernod Ricard, have been affected by this dispute.

items.title: રાહુલની પોસ્ટ- મોદી વિદેશી મદદથી વડાપ્રધાન બન્યા:ભાજપ અધ્યક્ષે કહ્યું- વિદેશી તાકાતો દેશમાં અસ્થિરતા ઇચ્છે છે, રાહુલનો ઉપયોગ થઈ રહ્યો છે
items.description: રાહુલ ગાંધીએ સોમવારે સોશિયલ મીડિયા X પર પોસ્ટ કરી. તેમણે લખ્યું કે નરેન્દ્ર મોદી વિદેશી મદદથી વડાપ્રધાન બન્યા અને તેમની જ મદદથી વડાપ્રધાન પદે ટકેલા છે. દરમિયાન, ભાજપ દેશભરમાં 'લોકતંત્ર બચાવો, અરાજકતા હટાવો' અભિયાન ચલાવી રહી છે. આ જ કડીમાં ભાજપ અધ્યક્ષ નીતિન નબીને કોલકાતામાં રેલી યોજી. અહીં તેમણે કહ્યું કે વિદેશી શક્તિઓ દેશમાં અસ્થિરતા લાવવા માગે છે. આ માટે રાહુલ ગાંધીનો ઉપયોગ કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે. પહેલાં રાહુલ ગાંધીની સંપૂર્ણ પોસ્ટ વાંચો નીતિન નબીન બોલ્યા- રાહુલ વિદેશી શક્તિઓની ટૂલકિટ કોલકાતામા…
